folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Define hierarchical container nodes that semantically organize various types of nodes and consolidate their functions.

basemap.name: Basemap
basemap.description: Specify the shared map style and viewport that ancestor nodes in the tree will use as their basemap.

shape.name: Shape
shape.description: Import country and administrative-area shape files from online data sources, analyze them, and present the results in coordinated map views.

location.name: Location
location.description: Import locations of geo-resources from online data sources, analyze them, and present the results in coordinated map views.

route.name: Route
route.description: Import transportation routes from online data sources, analyze them, and present the results in coordinated map views.

spreadsheet.name: Spreadsheet
spreadsheet.description: Import spreadsheet data, apply filtering, and expose the curated tabular items to other workflows.

styler.name: Styler
styler.description: Import spreadsheet data, filter them, and produce styling rules that drive themed visualizations on maps.

resolver.name: Resolver
resolver.description: Map heterogeneous schemas and properties into a unified structure so downstream plugins read consistent attributes.

linker.name: Linker
linker.description: Link related nodes into reusable sequences so workers and timelines can traverse shared workflows.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.description: Arrange descendant nodes as timeline frames and play them back as map animations inside a special folder node.
